g.text: All vectors stored in linear array • Search compares query with every vector
• O(n) search time (slow for large datasets)
Vectors partitioned into clusters • Search only nearest clusters
Graph-based: Start at top layer, navigate down to find nearest neighbors
64x compression! Vector split into sub-spaces, each quantized to codebook
<10K vectors: Use Flat index for 100% recall
10K-10M vectors: Use IVF for balanced performance
10M+ vectors: Use HNSW (with memory) or IVF+PQ (memory constrained)
